### download_figma_images
  fileKey                          Text           T1 required
      help: The key of the Figma file containing the images
      pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$
  nodes                            ObjectList     T2 required
      help: The nodes to fetch as images
    nodeId                         Text           T1 required
        help: The ID of the Figma image node to fetch, formatted as 1234:5678
        pattern: ^I?\d+[:|-]\d+(?:;\d+[:|-]\d+)*$
    imageRef                       Text           T1
        help: If a node has an imageRef fill, you must include this variable.
    gifRef                         Text           T1
        help: If a node has a gifRef fill (animated GIF), you must include this variable to download the animated GIF.
    fileName                       Text           T1 required
        help: The local name for saving the fetched file, including extension.
        pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+\.(png|svg|gif)$
    needsCropping                  Boolean        T1
        help: Whether this image needs cropping based on its transform matrix
    cropTransform                  Raw            T3
        help: Figma transform matrix for image cropping Edit this value as JSON. The schema describes a list of lists.
        raw because: a list of lists
    requiresImageDimensions        Boolean        T1
        help: Whether this image requires dimension information for CSS variables
    filenameSuffix                 Text           T1
        help: Suffix to add to filename for unique cropped images, provided in the Figma data (e.g., 'abc123')
        pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$
  pngScale                         Number         T1
      help: Export scale for PNG images.
      limits: Greater than 0.
      default: 2
  localPath                        Text           T1 required
      help: The directory to save images in.

### get_figma_data
  fileKey                          Text           T1 required
      help: The key of the Figma file to fetch, often found in a provided URL like figma.com/(file|design)/<fileKey>/...
      pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$
  nodeId                           Text           T1
      help: The ID of the node to fetch, often found as URL parameter node-id=<nodeId>, always use if provided.
      pattern: ^I?\d+[:|-]\d+(?:;\d+[:|-]\d+)*$
  depth                            Number         T1
      help: OPTIONAL.
